experiment: E56: neuron patching (E52's B2) on E54's key-dependent pair, and seeds 2-4 of the pair for r and S_lo
code: experiments/keydependent_patch/run.py; rules in src/commute/keydep_score.py (tests/test_keydep_score.py); B2 and its controls in src/commute/neurons.py (moved from experiments/baseline_neurons/run.py); fine-tunes, matched step, r and S in src/commute/keydep.py (moved from experiments/keydependent_elicit/run.py); S_lo by src/commute/steering.py steer_at with logodds_at; the separation rule is src/commute/elicit.py separation
claim: A key-dependent map the original model half-knows is read as 'elicited' by the route split and by no cheap activation baseline, mean-vector or neuron-patch.
null: Neuron patching separates the pair as r does; r's separation is a size or sparsity effect any input-dependent patch recovers.

settings.states_job1: E54's six saved weight changes experiments/keydependent_elicit/results/large/{elicit,cipher,cipher_own}_s{0,1}.pt, each checked against stage2.json finetunes[state].sha256; windows_{elicit,cipher}.pt (97 held-out windows each; fit half = indices 0, 2, ...; scoring half = 1, 3, ... (48))
settings.states_job2: seeds 2, 3, 4 of E54's recipe unchanged (keydep.elicit_ft, keydep.cipher_ft: E12's arm A, lr anchors.FT_LR, 300 steps, seed = the seed number): elicit at E12's scored step (first of 10/30/100/300 with held-out P(target) >= 0.5); the cipher read at the checkpoint in 1..30 whose summed Frobenius norm of delta-W is nearest the same seed's elicit norm (ties to the lower step), and at its own E12 step (cipher_own). elicit_s{2,3,4} and cipher_s{2,3,4} saved to experiments/keydependent_patch/results/large/ with sha256 in job2.json; cipher_own_s* read in the job, not saved
settings.precision: fp32 target model and decomposition, TF32 off; means in float64
settings.gain: G, G_fit, G_score: mean of log P_tuned(target) - log P_W0(target) at the answer position over all 97 held-out windows / the fit half / the scoring half (steering.gains)
settings.floor: a state is readable iff |G| >= 0.05 nats. E54's seed-spread term (2 x |G(s0) - G(s1)|, two seeds at the same step) is not used: with five seeds at possibly different steps it has no single definition, and E54's six states all had floor 0.05 with G 6.3 to 13.7, a hundred times over it. An unreadable state's numbers are reported, not scored (its rules read 'unreadable')
settings.b2_grid_note: E52's grid [1, 4, 16, 64, 256, 12288] with 1024 and 4096 added, so the plan's expected 'k50 > 1000' is readable (on E52's grid k50 = 12288 only says > 256). N16 (k = 16) is unchanged by the added points
settings.N16: E52's B2 (neurons.neuron_patch): the 12288 MLP GELU outputs ranked by |mean over the fit half of (tuned - W0) activation at the answer position| (stable sort, ties to the lower flat index); the top 16 take the tuned model's activations (its own forward on the same window) at every position of a W0 forward; N16 = mean over the scoring half of (log P_patched - log P_W0) / G_score; nan if |G_score| < 1e-6 (elicit.share_or_nan)
settings.k50: the smallest k on b2_grid whose share >= 0.5 (a tie at 0.5 counts); inf if no k on the grid reaches 0.5 (even all 12288 neurons give under half of G). k50_index = its position on the grid (0..7), or 8 when k50 is inf; the separation rule reads k50_index (finite and ordinal), as E52 did (amended 2026-10-30 pre-run: P1 reads min(k50_index, 6))
settings.r: E54 unchanged (keydep.readings): the route split's re-gating share of the least-squares split state over all 97 held-out windows, r = (L01 - L00) / (T1 - T0) in log-odds; nan if |T1 - T0| < 1e-6
settings.S: E54 unchanged (steering.b3): one mean steering vector per block input, block chosen on the fit half, share in nats on the scoring half
settings.S_lo: E54 Amendment 1 unchanged: steering.steer_at with logodds_at at B3's block; (steered log-odds rise over W0) / (fine-tune's log-odds gain), scoring half; nan if the denominator is within 1e-6 of 0
settings.seeds_scored: job 1: s0, s1 (E54's states). job 2: s0..s4, where s0 and s1's numbers are job1.json's (reproduced against stage2.json and amend1.json in job 1's stage 0) and s2..s4's are job2.json's

stage0_job1.order: first and alone on all six states; any miss exits 1 before B2
stage0_job1.checks: per state: sha256 equals stage2.json's; identity patch (all 12288 neurons replaced by W0's own activations from a separate forward on the same 48 scoring windows) |share| <= identity_share and max |log P - log P_W0| <= identity_max_abs nats; full residual patch (block 3's output replaced at every position by the tuned model's) |share - 1| <= full_patch_tol; B3's block equals stage2.json's layer; |r - stage2 r|, |S - stage2 S|, |S_lo - amend1 S_lo| each <= reproduce_tol; (amended 2026-10-30 pre-run) all 12288 neurons patched through neuron_edit move log P by at least full_width_min_rise nats (max over the scoring half)

tolerance_sources.identity_share: plan 1e-6. Measured floor: the identity patch share is the 48-window forward against W0 log P read on all 97 windows and sliced, the same comparison as E54 S_block0 (a zero vector), which read at most 9.5e-8 in share on these six states (stage2.json). 1e-6 is ten times that. It catches a stale activation or a broken forward, not a wrong site (it replaces a site with its own values); the full-width rise below is the site check (corrected 2026-10-30 pre-run, review finding 2)
tolerance_sources.identity_max_abs: E52's filed 1e-4 nats; E52 measured 1.7e-5 on E12's tasks (baseline_neurons.json stage0)
tolerance_sources.full_patch_tol: plan's 1e-3; E52 measured |share - 1| <= 1.3e-8 (baseline_neurons.json stage0). Kept loose as the plan wrote it: any miss is a bug, not rounding
tolerance_sources.reproduce_tol: 1e-6; measured floor 0 on an unchanged path on the cluster's L40: E54 Amendment 1 (job 46070) reproduced stage2.json's S to dS = 0 on all six states. If the job lands on a different card model, a miss under ~1e-5 with every sha256 matching is rounding, a stop to report, not a bug
tolerance_sources.full_width_min_rise: 1e-2 nats: a wrong hook site or an index_copy that copies nothing gives 0 (to rounding, 1.7e-5 at most, E52 identity); E52 read full-width shares 0.50-0.97 of G (5-13 nats), so a working path is hundreds of times over the bar

stage0_job2.order: first and alone, before any new fine-tune; any miss exits 1
stage0_job2.refuses_unless: job1.json exists with stage0 pass and P1_two status 'pass' (the decision tree: P1 failing on two seeds stops the experiment for the user), and job1.json and this file are committed unchanged
stage0_job2.checks: windows_{elicit,cipher}.pt sha256 equal stage1.json's; each task's keys and values equal stage1.json's (same keys, same values); W0's held-out geometric-mean P(target) |rate / stage1 rate - 1| <= rate_rel_tol; elicit_s0.pt sha256 equals stage2.json's and its r reproduces stage2.json within reproduce_tol
stage0_job2.tolerance_sources: the same forwards on the same windows as E54 (load_task, route_split), floor 0 on the same card model as above

separation_rule: E51's, as src/commute/elicit.py separation: elicit and matched cipher separate iff |mean elicit - mean cipher| > the larger within-kind range (max - min over that kind's seeds; strict: equal does not separate) and |gap| >= min_gap 0.2 (a tie at 0.2 separates). Verdict a_higher (elicit higher), b_higher (cipher higher), none, or unreadable (fewer than two values per kind, or any value missing, unreadable or nan). Absolute, in each metric's own unit (share of G for N16; grid index for k50)

P1.statement: B2 does not separate the pair: N16 and k50 each fail the separation rule, elicit against the matched cipher.
P1.rule: keydep_score.p1: separation of N16 and of min(k50_index, 6) (amended 2026-10-30 pre-run: indices 6, 7, 8 = k over 1000 are one bin), elicit_s* against cipher_s*. pass iff both verdicts are none; a separation in either direction fails; unreadable if either is unreadable
P1.scored_when: P1_two (job1.json, seeds s0, s1) is an interim reading that decides whether job 2 runs (it refuses unless P1_two passes). P1 of record is job2.json's P1 on all five seeds s0..s4. If job 2 never runs, P1_two is reported as the two-seed reading and P1 of record is 'not run'
P1.expected: N16 small on both kinds, k50 > 1000 (index 6 or more) on every state, no separation
P1.blind_to: changes carried by attention (B2 patches MLP neurons only); a separation that lives in which neurons are chosen rather than how much they carry; k50's resolution is the grid
P1.control: stage 0's full residual patch (share 1 within 1e-3: one site carries all of G) and identity patch (0)
P1.noise_floor: the within-kind range over seeds, the rule's own term; on E12's pair E52 read N16 from -0.031 to 0.019 and k50 = 12288 on all eight states
P1.rule_as_filed: keydep_score.p1: separation of N16 and of k50_index, elicit_s* against cipher_s*. pass iff both verdicts are 'none'; a separation in either direction fails (a cipher above the elicit map still tells the kinds apart); unreadable if either is unreadable

P2.statement: At five seeds r separates the elicit map higher and S_lo does not, and the ratio r gap / (|S_lo gap| + S_lo's larger range) is at least 3.
P2.rule: keydep_score.p2 on s0..s4: r's separation verdict 'a_higher', S_lo's verdict 'none', ratio = r gap / (|S_lo gap| + max within-kind range of S_lo) >= 3 (a tie at 3 passes). Unreadable if either separation is unreadable or the denominator is 0 (every S_lo equal: degenerate, shown to the user, not a pass). A negative r gap gives a negative ratio and fails
P2.expected: r elicit 0.70-0.80 vs matched cipher 0.18-0.28; S_lo gap under its range or under 0.2; ratio near E54's 5.6 (0.539 / (0.052 + 0.043))
P2.blind_to: a per-key split (all numbers are means over keys); a size effect common to both kinds
P2.control: seed-0 states reproduce stage2.json (r, S) and amend1.json (S_lo) within 1e-6 (job 1 stage 0); seed-0 elicit r again in job 2 stage 0
P2.noise_floor: from E54: 0.04 on r, 0.08 on S (seed ranges at two seeds)

P3.statement: The cipher stays a cipher: on seeds 2-4 the matched cipher's r is within 0.1 of the cipher's own-step r.
P3.rule: keydep_score.p3 on s2..s4: per seed |r(cipher) - r(cipher_own)| < 0.1 (strict: exactly 0.1 fails). A seed whose matched step equals its own step (same_state) differs by 0 by construction and is left out; pass iff every remaining seed passes; 'uninformative' if none remains; unreadable if any seed's r is missing, unreadable or nan
P3.blind_to: a drift common to both steps of the cipher

N16.W0: delta-W = 0: the patch moves nothing (rise 0 nats) but G = 0, so the share is nan by rule
N16.if_claim: elicit and cipher both 0.1-0.4, no separation (the plan's band; E52 read -0.03 to 0.02 on E12's pair, so a value under 0.1 on both kinds is still 'as claimed' for P1, which reads separation only)

r, S_lo at seeds 2-4.if_claim: r 0.70-0.80 vs 0.18-0.28; S_lo gap under its range or under 0.2

edge_cases.zero_or_negative_denominator: a share whose gain is within 1e-6 of 0 is nan -> its rule unreadable; P2's ratio denominator |S_lo gap| + range is >= 0 by construction, 0 -> unreadable; a negative G (the fine-tune lowered the target) gives a well-defined share and is scored as is
edge_cases.nan: any nan among a rule's values -> unreadable (elicit.separation, keydep_score.p3)
edge_cases.ties_at_bounds: |gap| == range: no separation; |gap| == 0.2: separates; ratio == 3: passes; P3 difference == 0.1: fails; share == 0.5 at some k: that k is k50
edge_cases.missing_state: a state absent from the record or under the 0.05 floor -> None -> unreadable (keydep_score.col)
edge_cases.k50_undefined: no grid k reaches half of G -> k50 = inf, k50_index = 8 (one past the grid), finite and scored; an unreadable state's k50 is not scored; binned with 4096 and 12288 at index 6 for P1 (amended 2026-10-30 pre-run)
edge_cases.same_state: a new seed whose matched cipher step equals its own step -> left out of P3; all three -> P3 uninformative
edge_cases.all_equal_k50: every state at the same index: gap 0, range 0 -> 'none' (P1's k50 half passes)
edge_cases.block0: job 2: |S_block0 x G_score| > 1e-5 nats on a new state exits (E54 stage 2 stop, restored 2026-10-30 pre-run)

decision_tree.P1 and P2 hold: write up as the headline, ask (a) Jain's readout
decision_tree.P1 fails (two seeds or five): stop, tell the user; the claim is narrowed to steering before any Qwen ask
decision_tree.P2 fails on the ratio floor only: report the ratio as 'small but directional'; ask whether (c) is still worth gating
decision_tree.P2 fails otherwise (r does not separate: not covered by the tree; tell the user
decision_tree.P3 fails: the matched-size reading is suspect; tell the user

departures: the separation rule's minimum 0.2 and the ratio bar 3 have no source; neuron patching departs from causal tracing (Meng et al. 2022) as E52 did (tuned activations into W0 at every position, ranking on a fit half, share of the fine-tune's gain); the B2 grid adds 1024 and 4096 to E52's; the gain floor is 0.05 alone (E54 also used its seed-spread term)
amended_2026_10_30_pre_run: Before any run, after the code review reports/reviews/2026-10-30_review_e56-code.md. (1) P1 k50 half: scored on min(k50_index, 6), so every k over 1000 (4096, 12288, none reach half: indices 6, 7, 8) is one value, as the plan expected ("k50 > 1000 on all states, no separation"). Reason: review finding 1: unbinned, with two seeds sharing an index the within-kind range is 0 and one grid step clears the 0.2 gap, so elicit [7, 7] against cipher [8, 8] (full-width share crossing 0.5, likely from E52s 0.50-0.97) would fail P1 and stop the experiment under an outcome the plan called no separation. Old rule kept in predictions.P1.rule_as_filed. (2) Stage 0 of job 1 adds a positive control on the neuron-edit path: all 12288 neurons patched must move log P by at least 1e-2 nats (max over the scoring half) on every state (E52 read full-width shares 0.50-0.97 of G, about 5-10 nats); the identity tolerance note no longer claims to catch a wrong site (finding 2). (3) Job 2 restores E54s block-0 steering stop on new states: |S_block0 x G_score| > 1e-5 nats exits (finding 3). (4) job1.json and job2.json record git_dirty beside git_head (finding 4). Nothing had run.
